'''Rifi''' was a type of sport fishing on [[Dorumaa]].

==Behind the scenes==
''[[Republic Commando: True Colors]]'' mentions the activity of "rifi fishing" once (page 225), but it is not made clear whether this refers to fishing for a type of fish known as a rifi (&agrave; la "bass fishing"), using a fishing style known as rifi fishing (&agrave; la "fly fishing"), or fishing in a location identified by the term rifi (&agrave; la "reef fishing").
